title: Four of the eleven internal-market purpose hints read differently from DR1 — all four lose their closing full stop, and one of them also writes "it's" where DR1 has "its" and abbreviates "for example" to "e.g.".

finding.frontend: The eleven options and their order match DR1 exactly, but four hints differ, all of them in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-purpose/copy/copy.en.js:5-19. Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift reads "has as it's aim, the sale of" and ends "(e.g. a gift)" with no full stop; Breeding ends "or produce offspring" with no full stop; Racing, competition, show or training ends "competitive or training events" with no full stop; Production ends "any other animal product or by-product" with no full stop. The other seven hints are identical to DR1, character for character.
finding.prototype: The same four hints read "has as its aim the sale of" and end "(for example a gift).", "or produce offspring.", "competitive or training events." and "any other animal product or by-product." DR1 uses the possessive "its" with no comma after it, writes "for example" out in full, and closes every one of the eleven hints with a full stop.
finding.difference: Replace the four hint strings with DR1's wording. One file, no template or logic change, and it can be done independently of everything else in this slice. "it's" for "its" is a plain error and "e.g." is against GOV.UK style, so this is worth doing whether or not the page-shape change lands.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "as its aim" or "(for example a gift)" in the rendered frontend purpose page — the captured DOM at fe-import-purpose shows "as it's aim, the sale of" and "(e.g. a gift)".
finding.verification: Extracted all eleven govuk-radios__hint blocks and all eleven labels from both rendered DOMs — fe-import-purpose and dr1-reason-for-import-internal-market-revealed — and compared them character by character. Every string quoted in this finding is verbatim on both sides: the frontend really does render "has as it's aim, the sale of" and "(e.g. a gift)" with no closing full stop, and DR1 really does render "has as its aim the sale of" and "(for example a gift).". Neither typo has been silently corrected here. The eleven option labels are identical on both sides in identical order, so the "options and their order match DR1 exactly" claim holds. Ran the falsifier: neither "as its aim" nor "(for example a gift)" appears anywhere in fe-import-purpose. Re-resolved copy.en.js:5-19, which is the purposeHints object and holds all four divergent strings. Rubric 2 fired on the count. CORRECT once the count is fixed.
finding.correction: Claimed: "Five of the eleven internal-market purpose hints read differently" and "The other six hints are identical". Both numbers are wrong and they do not add up — five plus six is eleven only if one hint is counted twice, which is what happened. The character-by-character comparison finds exactly four divergent hints: Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Racing/competition/show or training, and Production. Seven are identical. The title had split the Sale/gift hint's three separate defects — "it's" for "its", "e.g." for "for example", and the missing full stop — across three of its five, so one hint was counted as three. All four divergent hints lose their closing full stop; only Sale/gift carries the other two defects. Title and all three prose slots corrected to four and seven. The quoted strings themselves were all verbatim and are untouched.
